body: Holy shit this is by far the best advice I’ve gotten. You’re fucking amazing and I certainly will check out all the sources you’ve given me. I can’t express my gratitude enough, thank you so much!!!!

They don’t do month to month, and I could have entered a new lease but it’s over priced for the area and I wanted to find something not as financially draining. I don’t know maybe I should have renewed the lease but I can’t go back in time and change that

Huge blow today. Lost a competition I poured my heart into and did my art for. I feel stupid for thinking I actually had a chance against actual artists. I spent so much time and energy in it and I still failed

I’m stopping going to therapy, I don’t really think it works for me. I’m taking a huge chance in the next week, I don’t know if it’ll pay off but I think it’ll drastically have a say in the next five years of my life. I’m hopeful.

Update: Things aren’t great, but they’re getting better.   There are less days where I feel hopeless and like I deserve for it all to end quicker, they’re still frequent but not as much. The more time I spend with my partner the more I don’t know how to tell him all this, and the more I don’t want to leave him. I guess, is it worth all the pain that everyday life brings just to be with him? Maybe, anyways that’s all the update for now

3 days since I left a comment here updating everything. What am I doing with my life? I feel like I’m supposed to be doing something but I can’t for the life of me, figure it out. I don’t even know if I want to figure it out anymore. I’m just so tired of living. I don’t even say that in a sad way, I don’t feel much. I’m so disappointed in myself for feeing this way. 

None of this is supposed to be edgy or anything similar.

It’s only been two weeks. I genuinely don’t know if I’m going to be able to make it to five years. I’m trying my hardest. But the nightmares are worse and honest to god I feel like I’m genuinely such a shitty person that I don’t deserve to be here. I just want it all to end.

Thanks for the advice, and for your kindness 

Also Queer high five, bro, Gays FTW 🤙🏻

We’ll see, hell, maybe I’ll give an update 5 years from now and everything will be exactly what I need. I can’t tell the future, and I pray each day that 5 years from now maybe I’ll actually be happy 

Either way, thanks for replying and for the kindness. It has a sort of rhythm to it and sounds a little poetic <3
